slides.title: Armed group admits Shirka raid, disputes toll
OLA says it carried out the raid
slides.body: In a statement this week, the OLA acknowledged the October operation in Shirka woreda, Borkena reported, citing BBC Amharic.

slides.title: It disputes who was killed
slides.body: The group claims those killed were local militia, not civilians, and rejects the rights commission's findings.
